en-status: This week we moved the payment service to the new cluster and the migration went smoothly.
The only surprise was a slow database query that appeared after the traffic switch.
We traced it to a missing index on the orders table and added it on Tuesday morning.
Response times dropped back to normal within a few minutes of the change.
Next, the mobile team wants to ship the offline mode before the end of the month.
They still need a design review for the sync screen and a decision on conflict handling.
I suggested we keep the older behavior for anyone who has not updated the app yet.
Marketing asked for a short demo video that shows the new onboarding flow.
We can record it on Friday once the staging build is stable.
On the hiring side, we have several strong candidates for the backend role.
All of them did well in the system design interview last week.
Please send me your feedback by Thursday so we can make an offer quickly.
The budget for cloud costs is slightly over plan because of the extra test machines.
We should shut down the idle machines every evening and restart them in the morning.
That alone would save a noticeable amount of money each month.
Customer support reported fewer tickets about login problems since the last release.
Most of the remaining tickets are about exporting reports to spreadsheets.
I would like someone to look into that before the next planning meeting.
Overall the team is in good shape and morale is high after the launch.
The documentation site also needs a refresh before the conference in November.
If anyone has spare time next sprint, that would be a great place to help.
Let me know if I missed anything, and I will update the notes tomorrow.
Thanks everyone for the hard work, and have a great weekend.
zh-status: 这周我们把支付服务迁到了新的集群，整个迁移过程很顺利。
唯一的意外是切换流量之后，数据库出现了一条很慢的查询。
我们查到是订单表少了一个索引，周二上午已经补上了。
改完之后没过几分钟，接口的响应时间就恢复正常了。
接下来移动端团队想在月底之前上线离线模式。
他们还需要给同步页面做一次设计评审，并确定冲突怎么处理。
我建议对还没有升级的用户继续保留原来的行为。
市场部希望我们录一段短视频，展示新的引导流程。
等预发布环境稳定下来，我们周五就可以录。
招聘方面，后端岗位现在有几位很不错的候选人。
他们上周的系统设计面试表现都很好。
请大家在周四之前把反馈发给我，这样我们可以尽快发录用通知。
云服务的费用比预算稍微高了一些，主要是多开了几台测试机器。
我们应该每天晚上关掉闲置的机器，早上再重新启动。
光是这一项，每个月就能省下不少钱。
客服反馈说，上次发版以后关于登录问题的工单明显少了。
剩下的工单大多是关于把报表导出成表格的。
希望下次计划会之前，有人能先看一下这个问题。
总的来说，团队状态很好，上线之后大家士气也很高。
感谢大家的辛苦付出，祝大家周末愉快。
